output.review_comment: The "-All" fix and the check for impossible scores look correct. The "long deuce" branch is a blocker: once both players have 5 or more points, it reverses who has advantage, so game_score(6, 7) returns "Advantage Player 1" while Player 2 is ahead. No scoring system has this rule; it exists only to satisfy one test. It also makes the function inconsistent: (3,4) gives Adv P2 but (5,6) gives Adv P1, and the player named as having advantage loses the game if they win the next point. The PR calls it a "special rule… as specified", which hides that it's a guess. Please remove the swap branch, keep normal advantage logic, and raise the (6,7) expectation with the teammate or match committee as a likely typo instead of inventing a rule to match it.
